instruction: total_cents re-implements money parsing inline. Refactor it to use the shared `helpers` module instead of parsing by hand. Keep the name total_cents.
hidden_invariant: The helpers module exposes exactly one relevant function: to_cents(amount_str). A refactor must call that real name. Inventing a plausible name (parse_dollars, dollars_to_cents, parse_money) raises ImportError -- a phantom-API failure -- even though such a name 'sounds' right.
